capabilities: Capture product, Git and gift-idea bookmarks from the clipboard into designated notes
Configure which note each bookmark type is appended to
Archive notes into a configurable folder via command or right-click menu
disambiguation: Despite the second-brain framing, the current release only adds three bookmark-capture commands and one note-archive command.
extras: The author states the plugin is extremely incomplete and released mainly for personal convenience; much of the README is a design document describing planned features (journal, bibliography, web clipper, mobile and smart-speaker clients) rather than shipped functionality.
intentEvidence: All of these tools provide essential elements of the whole process, while not being fully integrated with each other
motivation: The author found that Todoist, Orgmode, Google Calendar, Zotero, Pocket, Goodreads and Habitica each cover only part of the GTD process and are not integrated with each other, and wanted one tool that spans all of it.
problem: Obsidian has no single integrated system that combines tasks, calendar, reference archive, journaling and habits for managing one's life.

requires.name: Full Calendar, Heatmap Calendar, Dataview, Citations, Pocket, Templater, Todoist Plugin

summary: GTD-based second-brain plugin that adds commands to capture product, Git and gift-idea bookmarks from the clipboard and to archive notes.
